## Task
Fit OLS polynomial regression (degree 2) to monthly average nominal yields of long-term US Treasury bonds for Jan 1971 - Jun 1973, then compare model's predicted July 1973 yield to actual published value.

## Steps
- [ ] Explore corpus structure and locate yield data files
- [ ] Extract long-term bond yields for Jan 1971 through Jun 1973 (18 months)
- [ ] Get actual July 1973 yield
- [ ] Perform OLS polynomial regression (degree 2)
- [ ] Calculate predicted July 1973 yield
- [ ] Compute absolute difference (rounded to 3 decimal places)
- [ ] Write final answer to /app/answer.txt

## Data Requirements
- Monthly average nominal yields (not inflation-adjusted)
- Long-term Treasury bonds
- Period: Jan 1971 - Jun 1973 (training data)
- July 1973 (prediction target)
